sentences.en: HUGO: Hi Chantal.
sentences.zh: HUGO: 嗨，香塔尔。

sentences.en: What did you think of the talk, then?
sentences.zh: 那么，你觉得那场讲座怎么样？

sentences.en: CHANTAL: Hi Hugo.
sentences.zh: CHANTAL: 嗨，雨果。

sentences.en: I thought it was good once I'd moved seats.
sentences.zh: 我觉得还不错，前提是我换了座位。

sentences.en: HUGO: Oh - were the people beside you chatting or something?
sentences.zh: HUGO: 哦——坐在你旁边的人一直在聊天，还是怎么了？

sentences.en: CHANTAL: It wasn't that. went early so that I'd get a seat and not have to stand, but then this guy sat right in front of me and he was so tall!
sentences.zh: CHANTAL: 并不是这个原因。我早早去了，好抢到一个座位，不用站着，结果有个男的就坐在我正前方，而且他个子特别高！

sentences.en: HUGO: It's hard to see through people's heads, isn't it?
sentences.zh: HUGO: 确实很难透过别人的脑袋看东西，对吧？

sentences.en: CHANTAL: Impossible!
sentences.zh: CHANTAL: 完全不可能！

sentences.en: Anyway, to answer your question, I thought it was really interesting, especially what the speaker said about the job market.
sentences.zh: 总之，回答你的问题，我觉得讲座内容非常有趣，尤其是主讲人谈到就业市场那段。

sentences.en: HUGO: Me too.
sentences.zh: HUGO: 我也是。

sentences.en: I mean we know we're going into a really competitive field so it's obvious that we may struggle to get work.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们都知道自己即将进入一个竞争极其激烈的领域，因此找工作可能会遇到困难，这再明显不过了。

sentences.en: CHANTAL: That's right - and we know we can't all have that dream job'.
sentences.zh: CHANTAL: 没错——而且我们也清楚，并非所有人都能获得那份‘理想工作’。

sentences.en: HUGO: Yeah, but it looks like there's a whole range of ... areas of work that we hadn't even thought of - like fashion journalism, for instance.
sentences.zh: HUGO: 是啊，但看起来似乎还有一大堆……我们之前甚至从未想到过的工作领域，比如时尚新闻业，就是个例子。

sentences.en: CHANTAL: Yeah - I wasn't expecting so many career options.
sentences.zh: CHANTAL: 对——我真没想到会有这么多职业选择。

sentences.en: HUGO: Mmm.
sentences.zh: HUGO: 嗯。

sentences.en: Overall, she had quite a strong message, didn't she?
sentences.zh: 总体而言，她的观点相当鲜明有力，对吧？

sentences.en: CHANTAL: She did.
sentences.zh: CHANTAL: 的确如此。

sentences.en: She kept saying things like 'I know you all think this, but and then she'd tell us how it really is.
sentences.zh: 她一直反复说类似‘我知道你们都觉得是这样，但……’这样的话，然后告诉我们实际情况究竟是怎样的。

sentences.en: HUGO: Perhaps she thinks students are a bit narrow-minded about the industry.
sentences.zh: HUGO: 也许她觉得学生对这一行业有些思维狭隘。

sentences.en: CHANTAL: It was a bit harsh, though!
sentences.zh: CHANTAL: 不过，她的说法未免有点尖锐了！

sentences.en: We know it's a tough industry.
sentences.zh: 我们当然知道这是个艰难的行业。

sentences.en: HUGO: Yeah - and we're only first years, after all.
sentences.zh: HUGO: 是啊——而且毕竟我们才刚上大一。

sentences.en: We've got a lot to learn.
sentences.zh: 我们还有很多东西要学。

sentences.en: CHANTAL: Exactly.
sentences.zh: CHANTAL: 没错。

sentences.en: Do you think our secondary-school education should have been more career-focused?
sentences.zh: 你觉得我们的中学教育本该更侧重职业规划吗？

sentences.en: HUGO: Well, we had numerous talks on careers, which was good, but none of them were very inspiring.
sentences.zh: HUGO: 嗯，我们确实听过很多关于职业发展的讲座，这很好，但没有一场特别鼓舞人心。

sentences.en: They could have asked more people like today's speaker to talk to us.
sentences.zh: 他们本可以多请一些像今天这位主讲人那样的专业人士来给我们做分享。

sentences.en: CHANTAL: I agree.
sentences.zh: CHANTAL: 我同意。

sentences.en: We were told about lots of different careers - just when we needed to be, but not by the experts who really know stuff.
sentences.zh: 我们被告知了各种各样的职业——虽然时机上确实需要了解这些信息，但讲解者却并非真正精通这些领域的专家。

sentences.en: HUGO: So did today's talk influence your thoughts on what career you'd like to take up in the future?
sentences.zh: HUGO: 那么，今天的讲座是否影响了你对未来想从事何种职业的想法？

sentences.en: CHANTAL: Well, I promised myself that I'd go through this course and keep an open mind till the end.
sentences.zh: CHANTAL: 嗯，我曾对自己承诺，会认真完成这门课程，直到最后都保持开放的心态。

sentences.en: HUGO: But I think it's better to pick an area of the industry now and then aim to get better and better at it.
sentences.zh: HUGO: 但我认为，现在就选定行业内的某个方向，然后努力不断提升自己，这样更好。

sentences.en: Audioscripts
sentences.zh: 听力原文

sentences.en: CHANTAL: Well.
sentences.zh: CHANTAL: 嗯。

sentences.en: I think we'll just have to differ on that issue!
sentences.zh: 我想我们在这一点上只能各持己见了！

sentences.en: HUGO: One thing's for certain, though.
sentences.zh: HUGO: 不过有一点是确定无疑的。

sentences.en: From what she said, we'll be unpaid assistants in the industry for quite a long time.
sentences.zh: 根据她所说，我们在业内将长期担任无薪助理。

sentences.en: CHANTAL: Mmm.
sentences.zh: CHANTAL: 嗯。

sentences.en: HUGO: I'm prepared for that, aren't you?
sentences.zh: HUGO: 我已经为此做好准备了，你呢？

sentences.en: CHANTAL: Actually, I'm not going to accept that view.
sentences.zh: CHANTAL: 实际上，我并不打算接受这种观点。

sentences.en: HUGO: Really?
sentences.zh: HUGO: 真的吗？

sentences.en: But she knows it's the case - and everyone else says the same.
sentences.zh: 但她自己也知道事实确实如此——其他人也都这么说。

sentences.en: CHANTAL: That doesn't mean it has to be true for me.
sentences.zh: CHANTAL: 这并不意味着这件事对我也一定成立。

sentences.en: HUGO: OK.
sentences.zh: HUGO: 好吧。

sentences.en: Well - hope you're right!
sentences.zh: 嗯——希望你是对的！

sentences.en: CHANTAL: thought the speaker's account of her first job was fascinating.
sentences.zh: CHANTAL: 我觉得那位演讲者讲述她第一份工作经历非常引人入胜。

sentences.en: HUGO: Yeah - she admitted she was lucky to get work being a personal dresser for a musician.
sentences.zh: HUGO: 是啊——她承认，能获得为一位音乐家担任私人服装师的工作，自己很幸运。

sentences.en: She didn't even apply for the job and there she was getting paid to choose all his clothes.
sentences.zh: 她甚至根本没去应聘这份工作，结果却已受雇负责为他挑选所有衣服。

sentences.en: CHANTAL: It must have felt amazing - though she said all she was looking for back then was experience, not financial rewar
sentences.zh: CHANTAL: 那感觉一定棒极了——尽管她说，当时她所追求的只是经验，而非经济回报。

sentences.en: HUGO: Mmm.
sentences.zh: HUGO: 嗯。

sentences.en: And then he was so mean, telling her she was more interested in her own /28 appearance than his!
sentences.zh: 接着那人还那么刻薄，竟说她更在意自己的外表，而不是他的！

sentences.en: CHANTAL: But - she did realise he was right about that, which really made me think.
sentences.zh: CHANTAL: 但——她确实意识到他说得没错，这真让我深思。

sentences.en: I'm always considering my own clothes but now I can see you should be focusing on your client!
sentences.zh: 我总是关注自己的穿着，但现在我才明白，你本该把注意力放在客户身上！

sentences.en: HUGO: She obviously regretted losing the job.
sentences.zh: HUGO: 她显然为失去那份工作而感到遗憾。

sentences.en: CHANTAL: Well, as she said, she should have hidden her negative feelings about him, but /28 she didn't.
sentences.zh: CHANTAL: 嗯，正如她所说，她本该隐藏起对他的负面情绪，但她没有做到。

sentences.en: HUGO: It was really brave the way she picked herself up and took that job in retail.
sentences.zh: HUGO: 她后来振作起来，接受零售业那份工作，真是非常勇敢。

sentences.en: Fancy a working in a shop after that!
sentences.zh: 在那之后居然还愿意去商店工作！

sentences.en: CHANTAL: Yeah - well, she recommended we all do it at some point.
sentences.zh: CHANTAL: 是啊——嗯，她建议我们所有人都至少尝试一次。

sentences.en: I guess as a designer you'd get to find out some useful information, like how big or small the average shopper is.
sentences.zh: 我想，作为一名设计师，你或许能从中获取一些有用的信息，比如普通购物者的身材是偏大还是偏小。

sentences.en: HUGO: I think that's an issue for manufacturers, not designers.
sentences.zh: HUGO: 我觉得这是制造商的问题，而非设计师的问题。

sentences.en: However, it would be /30 useful to know if there's a gap in the market - you know, an item that no one's stocking but that consumers are looking for.
sentences.zh: 不过，了解市场上是否存在空白点倒会很有用——你知道的，就是某种目前无人供货、但消费者却在积极寻找的商品。

sentences.en: CHANTAL: Yeah, people don't give up searching.
sentences.zh: CHANTAL: 是啊，人们不会轻易放弃搜索。

sentences.en: They also take things back to the store if they aren't right.
sentences.zh: 如果买到的东西不合适，他们还会把商品退回商店。

sentences.en: HUGO: Yeah.
sentences.zh: HUGO: 是啊。

sentences.en: Imagine you worked in an expensive shop and you found out the garments /30 sold there were being returned because they ... fell apart in the wash!
sentences.zh: 想象一下，如果你在一家高档商店工作，结果发现那里出售的服装因……洗涤后就散架而被大量退货！

sentences.en: CHANTAL: Yeah, it would be good to know that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: CHANTAL: 是啊，了解这类情况确实很有价值。

sentences.en: HUGO: Yeah.
sentences.zh: HUGO: 是啊。
